title: EWMA Principal Eigenportfolios of Equity Returns: Market Representation and Beta-Hedging Performance
abstract: arXiv:2611.20363v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This study examines whether an adaptively estimated principal eigenportfolio improves equity beta hedging relative to capitalisation-weighted and equal-weighted market benchmarks. Using stock returns from a historically changing S&P 500 universe, it constructs a portfolio from the leading principal component of an exponentially weighted second-moment matrix of volatility-standardised returns. The resulting portfolio, EWMA-PC1, is compared with SPY and RSP under a common beta-hedging procedure across randomly generated portfolios of varying sizes and weighting schemes. Evaluation considers variance reduction and average pairwise residual correlation, with paired blockbootstrap inference. EWMA-PC1 exhibits broad market participation and achieves greater mean variance reduction and lower average residual correlation than SPY across all tested configurations. translated_title: 股票收益的EWMA主特征值组合：市场代表性与贝塔对冲表现
translated_abstract: 本研究考察了适应性估计的主特征值组合相比市值加权与等权市场基准，能否改善股票贝塔对冲效果。研究使用历史上不断变化的标普500成分股收益数据，从波动率标准化收益的指数加权二阶矩矩阵的第一主成分构建投资组合。所得组合EWMA-PC1在统一的贝塔对冲程序下，与SPY和RSP在随机生成的不同规模和权重方案的投资组合上进行比较。评估指标包括方差降低幅度和平均两两残差相关性，并采用配对块自助法进行统计推断。结果表明，EWMA-PC1具有广泛的市场参与度，在所有测试配置下均比SPY实现了更大的平均方差降低和更低的平均残差相关性；其相对于RSP的增量优势则较小且结果不一。对于50只股票的Dirichlet组合……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文创新性地利用波动率标准化收益的指数加权二阶矩矩阵第一主成分构建自适应EWMA-PC1组合，实证证明其在股票贝塔对冲中方差降低效果优于市值加权基准SPY，但相对等权基准RSP的优势有限且不稳定。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an adaptively estimated EWMA-PC1 portfolio built from the leading principal component of an exponentially weighted second-moment matrix of volatility-standardised returns, demonstrating superior beta-hedging variance reduction over the capitalisation-weighted SPY benchmark, while its advantage over the equal-weighted RSP remains smaller and mixed.
